name: Cucumber, Tomato, and Onion Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 small white onion, diced (perhaps a sliced green onion could be substituted)
1 (or more, if in season) tomato, diced or wedged (optional, adds color)
Additional seasoning as you may desire (e.g. salt)

steps: Peel the cucumbers, either completely or leaving some green, in a pattern you prefer.
Slice cucumbers about ¼ inch (½ cm) thick.
Add vinegar and water, adjusting the proportions to your taste. The end result is that the other ingredients will be floating in clear liquid.
Refrigerate, then serve cool to cold, while the ingredients are still crisp.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
